cases.title: BROKEN VARIANT of W1246: the own-tag switch is off, so the copied downpipe keeps the original's tag (must FAIL)
cases.expected: This variant is wrong on purpose: with linking.copiedDownpipeGetsOwnTag off, each CR copy is left as AutoCAD copied it and CE shows '[CE] A downpipe copied with the pits could not be given its own link on this AutoCAD, so it was left as AutoCAD copied it. ...' (CloneSourceCopyRule.LeftAsCopiedLine). So 'history has ... given its own tag DP2 ...' fails, as do the DP3 lines, '$labB = 1' and 'history absent "could not be given its own link"'.
cases.why_not_unit: It exists only to prove W1246's checks go red when the fix is switched off.
